def create_build_configuration_process(repository, revision, **kwargs):
    """
    Create a new BuildConfiguration. BuildConfigurations represent the settings and configuration required to run a build of a specific version of the associated Project's source code.
    If a ProductVersion ID is provided, the BuildConfiguration will have access to artifacts which were produced for that version, but may not have been released yet.
    :return BPM Task ID of the new BuildConfiguration creation
    """
    # First, get the Project ID
    project_id = get_project_id(repository)

    # Get the ProductVersion ID
    if revision is None:
        product_version_id = get_product_version_id(repository)
    else:
        product_version_id = get_product_version_id(repository, revision)

    # Create the BuildConfiguration
    build_configuration = {
        "project_id": project_id,
        "product_version_id": product_version_id,
        "name": "BuildConfiguration {}".format(datetime.datetime.now()),
        "product_configuration_id": get_product_configuration_id(repository),
        "build_system": "Bazel",
        "repository_id": get_repository_id(repository),
        "repository_revision": revision,
        "build_root": "/tmp",
        "build_environment_id": get_build_environment_id(repository),
        "build_type": "Build",
        "build_name": "BuildConfiguration {}".format(datetime.datetime.now()),
        "build_tag": "BuildConfiguration {}".format(datetime.datetime.now()),
        "build_host": "localhost",
        "build_user": "admin",
        "build_start_time": "2017-11-17T17:37:40+00:00",
        "build_finish_time": "2017-11-17T17:37:40+00:00",
        "build_status": "Completed",
        "build_reason": "Initial build",
        "build_location": "http://localhost:8080/builds/1234",
        "build_environment_variables": [
            {
                "name": "TEST_ENV_VAR",
                "value": "test"
            }
        ],
        "build_parameters": [
            {
                "name": "TEST_PARAM",
                "value": "test"
            }
        ]
    }

    # Send the request
    return create_build_configuration(build_configuration,
